question: After fixing kernel distill_parameterized bugs (double-prefix in _common_prefix_and_suffix, Jaccard >=0.75 constant-anchor check, field-path relevance filter for body/headers/url only) and porting to src/spider/kernel.py, does real-LLM parameterized inheritance on WebArena-Verified v2 family hold-out (train on resource A, test on never-observed B, >=10 families >=60 tasks, 49 templates, duplication 0.9479) achieve EXECUTABLE >=0.75 and binding correctness >=0.90 with zero unsubstituted templates, success margin >=0.12 vs B-COLD/B-RAG/B-REPLAY/B-INSTR, false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.15] ECE <=0.15, and honest amortized saving >=25% vs COLD and <=0.85x vs RAG (family-stratified bootstrap CIs, deterministic verification, tokens+browser+retrieval+verification amortized f=10)?
hypothesis: A corrected kernel-integrated distill_parameterized() fixing three falsified bugs — (1) double-prefix in _common_prefix_and_suffix so full resource-B identifiers bind correctly (not truncated prefix), (2) structure-similarity Jaccard >=0.75 constant-value anchor check to reject pattern-absence hallucination (E1), (3) field-path relevance filter restricting _extract_varying_values to action-template-relevant paths only (body.*, headers.*, url/path, excluding top-level metadata provenance/state noise) — ported to src/spider/kernel.py with distinct slot naming per field-path (e.g., body.sku -> ${sku}, headers.X-Csrf-Token -> ${csrf_token}, url path segment -> ${resource_id}) at confidence 0.90, will enable a real-LLM agent (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or equivalent, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens, identical Playwright toolset navigate/click/fill/type/select/goBack/observe) learning 3-5 exemplars per family on resource A to resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action on never-observed resource B (zero exact value overlap for parameterized slots, family hold-out not random split) and achieve end-to-end (H1) EXECUTABLE >=0.75 and binding correctness >=0.90 with 0 unsubstituted ${} templates, (H2) task success >=0.12 absolute above each baseline B-COLD, B-RAG, B-REPLAY-TERX, B-INSTR on same held-out B set, (H3) false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN rate in [0.00,0.15] with ECE <=0.15, (H4) honest amortized cost per success (tokens+browser+retrieval+verification amortized over f=10, distill ~1000 tok added only to SPIDER) >=25% cheaper than B-COLD and ratio <=0.85 vs B-RAG, with family-stratified bootstrap 95% CIs not crossing null — demonstrating parameterized inheritance beyond narrow synthetic ceilings (EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801 audit PASS single-param 10/10, EXP-PRODUCT-33741671686 harness-only multi-param 21/21) and unblocking C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY gates.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if ANY primary gate fails on held-out B via real LLM+Playwright deterministic verification (not proxy): (F1) M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER <0.75 or M-BINDING-CORRECT <0.90 or M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES >0 among EXECUTABLE (double-prefix or slot collision not fixed); (F2) SPIDER success M-SUCCESS-SPIDER - max(B-COLD,B-RAG,B-REPLAY,B-INSTR) <0.12 (family-stratified bootstrap 95% CI lower <=0.02 or McNemar p>=0.05), i.e., no margin over strongest memory/instruction baseline; (F3) M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER >0.10 or M-UNKNOWN-RATE outside [0.00,0.15] or ECE >0.15 (contamination/abstention miscalibrated); (F4) M-AMORTIZED-SAVING-SPIDER-vs-COLD <25% at f=10 or M-COST-RATIO-RAG >0.85 (bootstrap CI crossing 1.0), i.e., no honest economics beyond cold/retrieval. MIXED if F1 passes but F2 fails (binds correctly but agent fails downstream verification/repair). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if: kernel fix not ported to src/spider/kernel.py or not exercised via real registry required_slots|template_slots + _bind, <60 valid tasks after dedup/zero-overlap filtering, WebArena-Verified v2 census not loaded (192 tasks/49 templates/duplication 0.9479/param_task 0.8958/AX 0.9 not verified), Playwright verification broken, LLM API unavailable >50% trials, or family hold-out leakage (B values overlapping A). Prior synthetic mock 72-task duplication-hardcoded ceiling does not count.

baselines.description: Cold LLM agent with no SPIDER memory: same model/tools/budget (15 steps, Playwright chromium headless, same prompt without retrieved mechanisms). Cost = measured LLM input+output tokens (API usage) + browser calls (count+ms) + latency per task. Upper-bound full-re-exploration cost; no retrieval, no verification shortcut, no distill. Tests whether SPIDER adds value beyond base agent on novel B identifiers.
baselines.expected: Success lower than SPIDER on held-out families; cost flat vs novelty; used denominator for saving ratio. SPIDER expected +0.12 success and >=25% amortized cheaper.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval / RAG over prior trajectories: same LLM retrieves nearest successful trajectory from training set A by Jaccard over intent+state keywords (threshold 0.30) and replays verbatim without parameter induction. Retrieval cost 200 tok + measured ms per task. If retrieved identifiers match test B at deterministic postcondition verification (_matches), reuse at 0 LLM tokens for matching prefix; otherwise fallback to COLD LLM exploration for mismatched steps. Hit/miss measured directly; family hold-out ensures many misses at B. Same verification logic as SPIDER.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.05 on held-out B (duplication 0.9479 is parameterized reuse, exact-copy 0.0781, so literal hit rare); overall success << SPIDER because without parameterization every novel B identifier triggers fallback. SPIDER expected success >= RAG+0.12 and cost <=0.85x RAG amortized.

baselines.description: 0-token exact replay (TERX/BrowserBash) with LLM fallback: if test task's full parameterized identifier sequence exactly equals a training trajectory A (exact string equality on action_template including path+body+headers, no parameterization), replay at 0 LLM tokens +1 verification browser call (50 tok, 90ms) +1 browser execution; otherwise replay fails deterministic verification and falls back to COLD LLM exploration for full task. Strongest exact-repeat economics baseline. Hit cost = 50 tok verification only; miss cost = COLD cost. Hit_rate measured inside compared set (expected ~0.0 on family hold-out, ~1.0 on same-resource control).
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.0 on held-out B (by design, B never observed) -> cost = COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than REPLAY on held-out where REPLAY misses and within 2x of REPLAY on same-resource control where REPLAY hits at 50 tok.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline: same LLM supplied with natural-language site instructions (e.g., WebArena shopping procedure) but no parameterized mechanism or retrieval. Instruction tokens 200 amortized over f=10 (20 tok/task). Cost = instruction amortized + full identifier-specific steps (agent must discover B identifiers). Tests whether instructions alone achieve transfer without SPIDER param slots.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below COLD but above SPIDER; success below SPIDER on multi-param families. SPIDER expected to beat INSTR by >=0.10 success and >=15% amortized cost.

baselines.description: Literal (zero-parameter) mechanism replay: distill literal mechanisms via current kernel distill() without parameter induction and attempt resolve on B via exact registry match. Tests that parameterization is necessary (literal should fail on unseen B). Same verification.
baselines.expected: Success ~0.0 on held-out B, EXECUTABLE 0.0, confirming literal cannot handle novelty. Validates that any SPIDER success is due to param slots not trivial match. If B-LITERAL success >0.15, family hold-out leakage suspect.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls exercising real pipeline on same substrate: (PC1) Same-resource literal hit: training resource A mechanism replayed on same resource A with identical identifiers must achieve hit_rate 1.0 via B-REPLAY-TERX pipeline with 0 LLM tokens +1 browser verification call (50 tok) and success 1.0; validates substrate can measure 0-cost case and Playwright deterministic verification works. (PC2) Multi-param regression on same A: harness-induced mechanism from 3 A observations with path+body+headers varying (same distill_parameterized as SPIDER) tested on same A via actual registry required_slots|template_slots/_bind/verify must resolve EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding correctness 1.0, success >=0.90, reused>=0.85, zero templates. Confirms induction works before testing generalization to B. Both use measured verification outcomes, not forced constants. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1: B-REPLAY same-A cost 50 tokens, 1 browser call, success 1.0, hit_rate 1.0. PC2: multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding 1.0, success >=0.90, B-LITERAL same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0. Thresholds frozen; family-stratified not needed for PCs (n=5-10).

null_control.description: Two null controls exercising real semantics: (NC1) Shuffled slot mapping: randomly permute learned parameter_slots -> identifier binding (e.g., swap ${sku} with ${store_id}) before SPIDER resolve on same held-out B tasks via actual registry/_bind/verify; each task incurs real retrieval+verify+fallback costs based on verification outcomes (mismatched binds fail verification and trigger repair/fallback cost, introducing variability). Expected |rho|<0.25 vs novelty and success <= B-COLD, false_accept elevated >=0.25, binding correctness <0.50, proving observed transfer requires correct parameterization not any reuse. (NC2) Random retrieval: SPIDER retrieval returns random registry entry instead of ranked match, UNKNOWN disabled, via actual ranking path; expected false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD, demonstrating ranking/gating matters. Both go through actual binding/verification so they CAN fail the expected null pattern if mapping truly matters (not guaranteed flat).
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 shuffled success <= B-COLD +0.05 and false_accept >=0.25 and binding correctness <0.50. NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD. If NC1 success >= SPIDER -0.05, observed SPIDER effect is spurious (task difficulty confounded) -> measurement invalid for param-inherit claim.

measurement_validity: 1. Real LLM execution (not token proxy): same approved model (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or equivalent approved haiku/flash, temperature 0.0, seed 42 where supported) with identical Playwright toolset (navigate, click, fill, type, select, goBack, observe DOM) and identical budget (max 15 steps, max 4096 output tokens, 30s per step timeout) across SPIDER/COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR. Each task cost = measured LLM input+output tokens via API usage (not formula), browser calls (count + wall ms), retrieval tokens/latency (200 tok+measured ms if SPIDER/RAG), verification tokens/latency (50 tok+measured ms if EXECUTABLE attempted), repair tokens/calls if verification fails (1 LLM step). Distill cost ~1000 tok amortized over f=10 added ONLY to SPIDER for amortized comparison (honest accounting). No bijective cost=250+500*10*novelty proxy; per AGENTS.md failure discipline bijective mock is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

2. Family hold-out with zero B overlap on WebArena-Verified v2 census: load from repo cache, /tmp/webarena, or verified CSV (192 shopping tasks, 49 intent_templates, duplication 0.9479 95% CI [0.9167,0.9792], exact-copy 0.0781 [0.0417,0.1198], param_task 0.8958, 36 families >=3 [34 >=4,33 >=5] per EXP-INTEL-35725763380 audit PASS). Deduplicate by template+intent hash; require >=10 families with >=3 tasks, each family has >=2 resource pools A/B with disjoint identifiers (SKU, store, user, issue IDs). Training uses 3-5 exemplars from A only; test B values have zero exact value overlap with A for parameterized slots (verified by value set intersection =0, logged). Family hold-out (not random split) prevents site identity leakage; hold-out families never seen during distill. Minimum 60 valid tasks (6 per family) required for decision; target 120-192 if LLM budget allows. Source, duplication handling, and family split logged in provenance.json with hashes; claim ceiling bounded to WebArena-Verified v2 or disclosed isomorphic mock only if 3 fetch attempts fail and ceiling explicitly downgraded.

3. Corrected kernel-integrated distill_parameterized: fix (a) _common_prefix_and_suffix double-prefix so full B identifiers bind correctly, (b) field-path relevance filter restricting _extract_varying_values to action-template-relevant paths only (url/path, body.*, headers.*) excluding top-level metadata/provenance/state noise, (c) structure-similarity Jaccard >=0.75 constant-value anchor check to reject pattern-absence hallucination. Distinct slot naming per field-path (body.sku -> ${sku}, headers.X-Request-ID -> ${request_id}, path segment -> ${store_id}) per Codex 41 prior PARAM-INHERIT attempts KERNEL-INTEGRATION-FALSIFIED guidance. Registry stores one parameterized mechanism per family at confidence 0.90 via actual registry write/read. At resolve, required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template); freshness gating behavioral_score 0.25 and confidence gating <0.80 -> UNKNOWN abstention; if UNKNOWN -> fallback to COLD LLM cost; if EXECUTABLE -> bound_action = _bind(action_template, params) via actual _bind and Playwright execution + deterministic postcondition verification (_matches on observed DOM/state after execution, not LLM-as-judge); on verification failure charge repair cost and count false_accept if binding wrong. Code path must be src/spider/kernel.py (graph allowed to patch src per Director mandate REOPEN) verified by audit diff and src hash, not only research harness copy.

4. Strong baseline execution on identical held-out set with identical LLM/tools/budget and same deterministic verification logic. B-RAG Jaccard TAU=0.30 and success follows verification (retrievable only if template matches). B-REPLAY exact action_template string equality to decide hit/miss. B-INSTR instruction tokens correctly amortized as 200/f. B-LITERAL uses literal kernel distill without slots. No baseline handicapped by unavailable tooling; all costs measured in same units (tokens, ms, calls). BrowserGym 1280x720 AX optional per Director dependencies but not blocking; Playwright alone suffices for this gate.

5. Honest end-to-end cost accounting with amortized maintenance: per-task cost measured as above; amortized cost per success = (total_tokens + distill_tokens/f)/success_rate where distill_tokens ~1000 added only to SPIDER and instruction_tokens 200 amortized as 200/f for INSTR only. Report both raw per-task and amortized (f=1,10,100) with family-stratified bootstrap 5000 resamples (family as block) for CI on cost ratios and success differences, plus deterministic verification. Latency includes LLM + browser + retrieval + verification + repair. Token, browser, latency reported separately and combined (weighted). Contamination <0.10 measured as registry cross-family leakage via unrelated mechanisms; random-patch false_accept operationalized as B-LITERAL and NC1/NC2 false_accept.

6. Verification and calibration: verification is deterministic postcondition _matches on observed DOM/state after Playwright execution (not LLM-as-judge). Verification AUROC, false_accept/false_reject, UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 contamination <0.10 measured; report verification success vs true task success correlation. UNKNOWN abstention measured per family; report ECE (expected calibration error) for confidence vs success with 10 bins, threshold 0.15. Freshness guard behavioral_score exercised where available; if distributed session store unavailable, disclosure not blocking.

7. Statistics honoring family structure: primary success comparison SPIDER vs each baseline uses paired McNemar or family-stratified bootstrap (family as block, 5000 resamples, seed 42), two-sided 95% CI; power >0.80 to detect 0.12 delta at n>=60 per condition (baseline 0.45 -> delta 0.12 power 0.82). Binding correctness and EXECUTABLE rate Wilson 95% CI. Cost ratio CIs via family-stratified bootstrap. No degenerate 5-bin Spearman with ties; family-clustered permutation for null controls. Trajectories not treated as independent; family is resampling unit. Significance requires both primary success margin and EXECUTABLE/binding gates.

8. Prereg frozen before any outcome-bearing measurement; code (src/spider/kernel.py patch), fixtures, model version, proxy constants, thresholds hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, random.seed 42, LLM seed 42), all hashes logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV with tokens, calls, latency, success, bound_action, verification, UNKNOWN, false_accept, ECE bins; registry JSON with slots/templates; cost_config JSON; Playwright traces sampled; provenance.json with commits, run ids, dataset hashes, WebArena census verification.
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of (C1)-(C6) measured via actual real-LLM+Playwright deterministic verification pipeline (not proxy): (C1) M-SUCCESS-SPIDER >=0.65 and > B-COLD by >=0.12 absolute and > B-RAG by >=0.12 and > B-REPLAY by >=0.12 and > B-INSTR by >=0.10, with family-stratified bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0.02 for each margin and McNemar two-sided p<0.05; (C2) mechanism quality M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER >=0.75 (Wilson lower >=0.65) and M-BINDING-CORRECT >=0.90 (Wilson lower >=0.80) among EXECUTABLE with M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES =0; (C3) safety S-SAFETY: M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER <=0.10 and M-UNKNOWN-RATE-SPIDER in [0.00,0.15] on valid B (no excessive abstention) and B-LITERAL success <=0.15 on same B (literal fails, confirming param necessity) and PC-B-LITERAL-EXPECTED fail validated; (C4) economics E-ECON: M-AMORTIZED-SAVING-SPIDER-vs-COLD >=25% cheaper at f=10 (cost per success) with bootstrap CI not crossing 1.0 and M-COST-RATIO-RAG <=0.85 with CI upper <1.0; (C5) controls: PC1 same-A replay hit_rate 1.0 cost 50 tok success 1.0 PASS and PC2 multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0 binding 1.0 success >=0.90 PASS; NC1 shuffled success <= B-COLD +0.05 and false_accept >=0.25 and NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD (NCs through real bind/verify); (C6) calibration: UNKNOWN cases have confidence <0.80 or required_slots missing, ECE <=0.15 with 10 bins, verification AUROC >=0.75 where measurable, contamination <0.10. FALSIFIED if any C1-C4 fails on valid substrate (excluding PC/NC substrate failures which are MEASUREMENT_INVALID). MIXED if C1 margin fails but C2 passes (binds correctly but agent fails downstream verification/repair). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if harness cannot induce distinct slots (collision), registry/resolve not exercising real required_slots/_bind via src/spider/kernel.py, <60 valid tasks after dedup/zero-overlap, WebArena-Verified v2 census not verified (192/49/36/dup 0.9479/param_task 0.8958/AX 0.9), LLM API unavailable >50% trials, or verification broken (substrate failure not scientific falsification per AGENTS.md). All thresholds frozen; single primary outcome is C1 success margin plus C2/C4 gates.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: C-PARAM-INHERIT advances from EXPERIMENTAL (narrow synthetic ceilings: 10 single-char 5.42% saving, 21/21 harness-only multi-param not kernel, 41 prior attempts KERNEL-INTEGRATION-FALSIFIED/PARTIAL, last 3 PRODUCT MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to double-prefix bug) to VALIDATED at bounded real-LLM multi-param ceiling (WebArena-Verified v2 family hold-out, path+body+headers, real Playwright deterministic verification, parameterized transfer beyond retrieval/replay). Establishes first direct measurement that multi-parameter mechanisms learned on A generalize to never-observed B with EXECUTABLE binding and quantified honest economics (success +0.12 vs strongest baseline, 25% amortized saving at f=10, false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN calibrated, ECE <=0.15). Unblocks C-LLM-INHERIT (real LLM inheritance vs strong baselines gate, AWM 24.6%/51.1% and TVCACHE 70% hit baselines) and C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY (amortized economics with honest distill/retrieval/verification accounting) for scale-up to Docker full-DOM hosting; informs productization vs TERX 0-token replay dominance (SPIDER wins where replay misses). Authorizes kernel promotion of corrected distill_parameterized with distinct slot naming per field-path to src/spider/kernel.py (promotion_ready true, pending kernel tests). No immediate SHIPPED; requires replication on production WebArena hosting and freshness guard hardening before SHIPPED.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at narrow synthetic ceiling (or bounded REJECTED for multi-param real-LLM setting: parameterized transfer does not beat cold/retrieval/replay/instructions on held-out families). If MIXED (binds but no success margin), mechanism binds correctly but downstream agent/verification fails -> product must investigate Playwright execution, verification, or agent prompt, not just induction. If SPIDER not beating B-RAG/B-REPLAY where RAG/REPLAY already miss on hold-out (duplication 0.9479 is 91.8% parameterized reuse, exact-copy 0.0781), multi-parameter inheritance adds no economics beyond retrieval or exact replay, supporting caching-vs-generalization tension that exact replay dominates where reusable; Product should redirect next cycle to higher-leverage gates per Director portfolio: C-FRESHNESS distributed session/UNKNOWN abstention, C-DELTA-REPAIR localized repair on nginx HIT/SWR/SIE verified substrate (Director dependencies runtime/graph), or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE calibrated resolution, and defer C-PRODUCT-ECON scale-up to full Docker hosting. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to induction collision, verification broken, <60 tasks, or LLM keys unavailable, priority is fixing kernel src/spider/kernel.py integration (double-prefix, Jaccard, field-filter distinct slot naming) and runtime verification AUROC substrate before re-testing param-inherit economics. Negative still high information: definitively closes real-LLM multi-param transfer at this substrate and resolves 41-attempt starved bottleneck and tunnel flags (graph 9/10 FRESHNESS, frontier 13/15 TV).

Each run ~8-12 LLM calls x ~1500 tokens avg =12k-18k tokens ~$0.04-$0.08 per run at gpt-4o-mini pricing ($0.15/1M in, $0.60/1M out). Total $15-$60; at minimum 60 tasks $15-$30. Either a positive (multi-param EXECUTABLE transfer beating COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR on never-observed B with honest tokens+browser+retrieval+verification amortized f=10 and calibrated UNKNOWN/ECE) or a valid negative (no margin vs retrieval/replay on family hold-out where duplication 0.9479 requires genuine parameterization, exact-copy 0.0781) decisively changes product decision: (1) whether C-PARAM-INHERIT advances EXPERIMENTAL->VALIDATED and unblocks C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY scale-up vs premature extrapolation closure (6 vacuous logistic=constant null), (2) whether kernel fixes (double-prefix, Jaccard >=0.75, field-path filter distinct slot naming) justify src/spider/kernel.py promotion despite prior KERNEL-INTEGRATION-FALSIFIED/PARTIAL, (3) whether parameterized inheritance beats TERX 90ms exact-replay and RAG retrieval dominance at low-to-moderate template novelty (duplication 0.9479) and informs commercial viability with honest amortized maintenance.
